recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a male figure in denim attire, seated backwards on a classic bentwood chair within a moody, blue-toned industrial warehouse featuring wet floors and hazy light streaming through high windows.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center balanced by large-scale typography on the left
Cool blue atmospheric lighting contrasting with warm skin tones
Reflective wet floor mirroring the subject and chair legs
Hazy background windows providing a geometric grid structure
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue color cast in the environment
Seated pose with arms resting on the chair back

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, full body visible from head to toe, seated.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white display text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the chair, across the floor reflections, and up through the vertical typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant atmospheric space on the left side, filled with haze and large-scale text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and steel blue (environment and denim)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and flesh tones (skin and chair wood)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast between the white text and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to blues, grays, and natural wood tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses flat terminals and uniform stroke weight
Secondary text uses high-contrast serifs with extreme horizontal tracking
Vertical stacking with tight leading for the main display
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower line of main text features a semi-transparent or textured fill to allow background details to show through
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, condensed sans-serif and a light, wide-tracked serif.
graphicDevices: Textured fill on secondary display line
Horizontal rule-like alignment of the subtitle

preserve: Condensed verticality of the main name
Wide tracking of the bottom line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold verticality of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary high-contrast serif look for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in his 40s with short dark hair, smiling, wearing a denim shirt and blue jeans, sitting backwards on a wooden bentwood chair. The setting is a dark industrial warehouse with a wet, reflective concrete floor and large windows in the background emitting a hazy blue light. The overall atmosphere is cool-toned and cinematic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically stacked text on the left side. The top word should be solid white in an extra-condensed sans-serif. The second word below it should be the same font but with a semi-transparent, textured silver fill. Below both, add a single line of all-caps serif text with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly blue and atmospheric?
Is the subject wearing a full denim outfit?
Is the floor visibly wet with reflections?
Is the typography left-aligned and vertically stacked?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
Amount of water/reflection on the floor
Specific texture applied to the second line of text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Realistic fabric textures in the denim

postGenerationChecks: Check that the chair legs interact correctly with the floor reflections
Ensure the condensed font does not look stretched or distorted
Verify the blue haze doesn't obscure the subject's face
Confirm the wide-tracked serif text is legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial setting + blue atmospheric lighting + denim-clad subject + high-contrast condensed typography = Modern Country/Rock Aesthetic
